finalText:
**Wrote the 4.2.0 section** into [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

Out of 380 commits and 127 merged PRs, almost everything was dep bumps, refactors, and test churn. One real feature and ten real fixes.

Added: webhook deliveries now retry automatically on failure, with backoff.

Fixed: trace id survives retries, null-cursor pagination crash, socket-drop timer leak, connection pool not closing on shutdown, wrong latency histogram units, expired tokens returning 403 instead of 401, a duplicate outgoing header, a doubled trailing slash on retried URLs, empty allowlists blocking everything, request bodies leaking into logs, and a clearer token-parser error message.

No breaking changes. The node-version and nvmrc commits were just repeated pins, not an actual bump, so I left Breaking out.

Next: check the two log-related fixes with legal or security before publishing, since "request bodies in logs" may need a disclosure note.
